svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make six, two per capsule. Print ASA flat, 100 % infill.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ring 41.5 mm outside, 34 mm inside, 15 mm long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print one first and check it: it must be a light press fit on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the capsule tube and slide freely in an offcut of the stake

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pipe (bore 41.9 mm). Adjust the outside size in steps of 0.2 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: one collar flush with each end of the capsule, with a drop

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of polyurethane adhesive. They hold the capsule on the pipe axis

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so it tilts with the pipe; 0.2 mm clearance to the bore.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The lower collar rests on the stand tube's top rim.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: on the capsule, both collars turn freely in the pipe offcut

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and the capsule does not rock when held level.
